title: 第204章 势力实力第203章 嫌疑瞳术
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 第204章势力，实力？
陈然愣了一下，
不过想到眼前的那男人除了是镇狱司负责人外，还是林家的二少爷。
大舅哥总不能坑自己吧？
陈然心中这么想着，也没有拒绝，跟着林盛绕过看台。
两人一前一后，在途经一条长道时。
“林兄，这人我感觉有些不同。”
远处飘来声音，二人面前不知何时出现了一位人影，
陈然看着远处那白发男人，认出了此人正是之前给他留过深刻印象的斩妖队成员。
夏安也注视着前方的俊朗青年，他从来没有见过陈然，却不知为何在动用先天瞳术时，从其人身上感受到了一丝不同寻常的气息。
虽然气息隐藏的极深，但他却隐隐察觉到了一丝不对劲。
那人一袭玄衣，年纪不大，黑色长发束在头顶。
夏安正欲向前问询，却突然感觉撞到了个铁柱子上，头顶前方不知何时多出了一道阴影。
“怎么了，夏安？”
林盛半个身子拦在中间，语气平和，但却带着一丝丝警告。
霎时间，夏安心中就已经有了判断，此人必定跟林家有脱不开的关系。
“没事，就是看这位有些面生？”
“这是天牢新晋的狱监，陈然。”还未等陈然开口，林盛便先行做出了介绍：
“这位是斩妖队的总队，夏安。”
“夏大人。”
陈然抱拳，礼貌行礼。
这种态度算不上刻意献媚，但对于他这个身份来讲，对标的可是朝廷三品大官。
常理来讲，寻常的狱监见到多半都得抖三抖。
可这青年的态度可谓是平静至极，放在狱卒当中可谓是无比少见。
夏安转头看向身旁高大男人，问道：
“你认识？”
“算是吧。”
林盛的态度说不上客气，但也暗中表达出了很多意思。
夏安是愣了一下，随后抬了抬眉毛。
本来想追问的话，给硬生生憋回了心间。
在京城这寸金寸土的地方，势力可谓是错综复杂，谁也不知道每天面对的人到底有何背景。
就算是在内城随便拉来一个百姓，往上深究关系网或许也能联系到豪门大族。
想要在京城混得开，三分靠实力，七分看势力。
纵使他为斩妖队总司之徒，又是最年轻的辑妖队长，身份极高。
但要在镇魔司内往上细究，也排不上最高的背景。
镇魔司虽然是朝廷重要部门，但最终的领导层并非是皇室，而是真正的世家。
一想到此人与林家又扯上了关系，夏安就感到一阵头疼：
“早说你俩认识，我就懒得趟这趟水了。”
“算了，还是让他们林家自己去查吧……”
夏安在心中腹诽，最后无奈摇摇手回复：
“修为不错，保持住。”
“多谢，大人指点。”
陈然刚想抱拳行礼，抬头却见，面前的白发男人已经消失得无影无踪。
“不用管他，继续走。“
陈然只好先跟着林盛继续走下去，想看看他葫芦里到底卖的什么药。
content_en:
Chapter 204 Power, strength?
Chen Ran was stunned for a moment,
However, I thought that the man in front of me was not only the person in charge of the Prison Suppression Department, but also the second young master of the Lin family.
Brother-in-law, you can’t cheat yourself, right?
Chen Ran thought this in his mind and did not refuse. He followed Lin Sheng around the stands.
The two of them were passing through a long road, one behind the other.
"Brother Lin, I feel something is different about this person."
There was a sound in the distance, and a figure appeared in front of the two of them.
Chen Ran looked at the white-haired man in the distance and recognized that this man was a member of the demon-slaying team who had left a deep impression on him before.
Xia An also stared at the handsome young man in front of him. He had never seen Chen Ran before, but for some reason, when he used the innate eye technique, he felt an unusual aura from him.
Although the aura was extremely hidden, he faintly noticed something was wrong.
The man was dressed in black clothes. He was young and had long black hair tied on his head.
Xia An was about to ask forward, but suddenly felt that he bumped into an iron pillar, and a shadow appeared in front of his head.
"What's wrong, Cheyenne?"
Lin Sheng blocked half of his body in the middle, his tone was calm, but with a hint of warning.
In an instant, Xia An already made a judgment in her mind that this person must have an inseparable relationship with the Lin family.
"It's okay, I just think this guy looks a little unfamiliar?"
"This is the new prison warden of Tianlao, Chen Ran." Before Chen Ran could speak, Lin Sheng introduced him:
"This is the head of the Demon Slayer Team, Xia An."
"Master Xia."
Chen Ran clasped his fists and saluted politely.
This attitude is not deliberately flattering, but for his status, the target is a third-rank official of the imperial court.
Generally speaking, most ordinary prison guards would tremble when they see him.
But this young man's attitude was extremely calm, which was extremely rare among the jailers.
Xia An turned to look at the tall man beside him and asked:
"You know him?"
"So be it."
Lin Sheng's attitude could not be described as polite, but he also secretly expressed a lot of meaning.
Xia An was stunned for a moment, then raised his eyebrows.
If I wanted to ask further questions, I had to hold it back.
In a place like the capital, where every inch of land is precious, the forces are so complex that no one knows the background of the people they face every day.
Even if you recruit a random commoner in the inner city, you may be able to contact a wealthy family if you dig deeper into the network.
If you want to get along in the capital, three points depend on strength, and seven points depend on influence.
Even though he is a disciple of the Demon Slaying Team's Commander-in-Chief, he is also the youngest Demon Collection Captain and has a very high status.
But if you look closely within the Demon Suppression Department, it is not ranked as the highest background.
Although the Demon Suppressing Division is an important department of the imperial court, its ultimate leadership is not the royal family, but a real aristocratic family.
Xia An felt a headache when he thought that this person was related to the Lin family again:
"If I had told you that you two knew each other, I would have been too lazy to wade through this water."
"Forget it, let the Lin family investigate on their own..."
Xia An cursed in his heart, and finally waved his hand helplessly and replied:
"Your cultivation is good, keep it up."
"Thank you, sir, for your advice."
Chen Rang just wanted to clasp his fists and salute, but when he looked up, he saw that the white-haired man in front of him had disappeared without a trace.
"Don't worry about him and keep walking."
Chen Ran had no choice but to continue walking with Lin Sheng, wanting to see what medicine he was selling in his gourd.
